String Theory makes no testable claims. If you subscribe to Popper's philosophy (falsificationism) of what science is, then String Theory isn't even science, and regardless of what philosophy you subscribe to it's definitely not a theory.

Popper says that for something to be scientific it has to make a claim that can be proven false. Since something cannot be proven true, but only shown to be likely, the only thing that can be proven is when something isn't true, and even then not everything can be proven false. According to him science only deals with things that can be proven false, and only things that are not proven false end up as scientific consensus. Consensus is when an idea is not proven true, but it's likely to be true, and hasn't yet been proven false (many people have to have used this process).

A theory is an idea that has been experimentally not been proven false. String theory makes no testable claims, therefore no test can be performed to prove it false, or likely to be true. Therefore String Theory should be called String Hypothesis (because it is an educated guess).
